# The Plank of Theseus (忒修斯的船板)

> "When AI replaces every part of the ship, what is the unreplaceable plank of a story?"
> 「当 AI 替换掉所有零件，什么才是故事换不掉的那块船板？」

The Plank of Theseus (`https://plankoftheseus.com`) is the bilingual literary & craft home of **Chuanban (忒修斯的船板 / Arcadia)** — fiction writer, AI-workflow explorer, and essayist on the Eastern Wuxia, Xianxia, and Webnovel narrative canon.

## Primary Channels
- **Official Site (English / Bilingual)**: https://plankoftheseus.com/
- **Substack Newsletter**: https://plankoftheseus.substack.com/
- **Chinese Archive (华语主站 · 157+ Essays)**: https://chuanban.cc/
- **My Project (船板写作工具集)**: https://plankoftheseus.com/projects/
- **Open-Source Writing Exoskeletons (GitHub)**: https://github.com/Anarcadia
- **X / Twitter**: https://x.com/Arcadia_Bao
